clips.title: The story
paras: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Ragnar Thunderbrew keeps the family tavern supplied and its patrons fed. The dwarven brewer is known across Dun Morogh for the family's Beer Basted Boar Ribs.

Ragnar Thunderbrew tends the kitchen and brewing work at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Mountaineers, travelers, and gnome refugees fleeing Gnomeregan gather there. His Beer Basted Boar Ribs, made with dwarven ale, are a Dun Morogh specialty. Supplies have grown hard to find since his usual meat provider enlisted in the King's Army. Ragnar now relies on wandering mountaineers and hunters to bring fresh crag boar flanks to the kitchen.

Across Ironforge territory, the Thunderbrew name is known for dwarven drink and tavern life. Ragnar has kept the distillery running since his older brother, Grimbooze Thunderbrew, disappeared in a drunken haze a few harvests ago. He guards the family's brewing heritage against thieves such as the Dark Iron dwarves, who stole the recipe for Thunderbrew Lager. With patrons restless, supplies scarce, and disputes breaking out in the tavern, Ragnar keeps the taps flowing and travelers fed in Kharanos.
